reviews.text: IBS issues. This application is good since it helps me see my triggers and helps me better choices…

Great to keep track of BM. I love this app because I suffer from IBS-C. There are times where I haven’t had a BM for 16 days. It makes you feel really bad and you don’t want to move or eat and it is not healthy at all. With this app I can make sure that I don’t go more than 7 days without having a BM. I can keep track of the consistency and timing of my last BM and make sure that I don’t end up dying because I haven’t had a BM

Fantastic app. Over the years I have used app after app in the pursuit of finding one that met my needs and worked the way I wanted it to. Something easy to use and quick to enter my meal and BM information without being cumbersome. THIS ONE IS IT. I cannot say enough good things. I am so thankful that I stumbled upon this app. It’s exactly what I have been looking for. I will say that maybe entering notes should be in its own section rather than being grouped and hidden in the “what have you eaten” section. Or perhaps the section should be worded differently because as it is now it isn’t logical, but for the most part this app is damn near flawless. 5 out of 5 stars.

It’s a good database, but not much more. I find the app easy to use. It is well laid out, easy to navigate and easy to add custom fields/tags. 

The reports do a good job laying everything out, however I expected a bit more ‘intelligence’ from the app. I was looking for some sort of correlations listed for types of food eaten and times and how they line up with my BMs and the details of the BMs. 

I’m sure we are all different, however my triggers are not immediate. I’m finding that they are often from the day before, or at least a meal or two before. The app lays all of your inputs out nice and neat, however you have to do your own sleuthing to figure out triggers and timings. 

Maybe my expectations were just too high.
Too pretty to be useful. The graphs/ data is simplified so far (e.g. not even axis labels on compound views) that it’s impossible to glean any insights from the data.
Simple yet effective. App is simple and i enjoy that quality about it . Sometimes it’s nice to have catchy fun apps to track things but for IBS i enjoy the simplicity.

Please fix these issues. 1. Everywhere you show the date, please show the day of week as well. I forget to enter things sometimes. When I go back to fix things up, I think of the day of week, not the date. 
2. In History, all entries with times should be shown in time order and not separated by category - BMs and food should be listed all together. This would make it easier to see if what’s eaten is having an effect on BMs
3. If you use the time control to enter a time for meals, the text afterward is smaller than it should be. You have to close that entry and reopen it to see the normal size text.

Helpful tool for me!. I was looking for a way to keep track of my foods to help with ID’ing possible gut triggers. Bowelle is doing that, plus enabling me to see my daily history at a glance. I’ll either use it myself or share it with a dietitian if I decide to work with one. I’m very glad I found the Bowelle app!

Accurate. I’ve been using Bowelle for 2 weeks now. I’m able to store everything I eat for the day, track bowel movements, water intake, and created fields for BP.
The notes function allows me to document stressors to rule out food as contributing to IBS.
This is an AMAZING app and you don’t have to pay for any modifications.

Easy and helpful. I don’t have IBS, but I do have another chronic intestinal issue. This app is so simple and straightforward, very user-friendly. reviews.text: So far so good. I have IBS (Constipation) and it’s very helpful for tracking down my bowel movements. I haven’t had it for a long time but maybe it’ll help me understand what I need to eat to be regular!

it’s a good app but could use more features. what i really want is to be able for this app to provide me a list of foods based on my inputs that cause discomfort or toilet issues. 
i get that you can search by type of movement etc, but that is too manual for me. it means i have to scroll through all my responses and filter out the highest incidences of food types. 
why not show me a word cloud or a graph of which items (vegetables, dairy, spice, etc) cause discomfort based on my history? 
if not, this app doesn’t do much more than a paper diary. i dont mind paying for this support, but from what i could see, this isn’t a feature of “premium” either,

Great app!!!. When you have a lot of health conditions that mess with your daily life, it’s so helpful to have an app like this to track your health. Between IBS and medications that mess with my stomach, it’s been nice to have this app to track movements to ensure I don’t go too long without having one. Only one week in and really enjoying this app and how much it’s helped me already. I’ve struggled with various gut issues, mainly bloating, for literal years. Years and years! And I’ve done food journals in the past, but it’s a burden to carry around a physical journal, so I’ve tried many apps to help. I lost interest in navigating their clunky designs after about 2 days, and always struggled to get a good historical view of all my entries anyway, so what was the point?? Not with Bowelle! I actually look forward to entering in what I eat and how I feel, and the historical view is *awesome! Only used for about two weeks now, but met with a doc and could very quickly, succinctly review my food journal and find a potential trigger straight away. Will definitely be a daily user of this app!!
Helping. This is really helping me keep track, so I have documented info when I go to my digestive specialist.
Crazy gut. Trying to figure out my gut and food issues. This app is so easy and convenient. Will give me valuable insights at my next doctor appointment.

Great for IBD to find triggers. Loving this app. Really helping me

This app allows you to track bowel events, write notes, track food, mood, and stress. Doing all this can reveal correlations that can reduce symptoms. Making changes can then be correlated to reveal success. So using this app allows for experiments to see results.
On the other hand, you can choose to track only what you wish. 
The owner is very amenable to feedback. I wasn’t able to record the events in real time and requested a way to record after the fact. The owner created a method to do that. I’ve been meaning to write a positive review ever since. Finally! Grateful for this very easy-to-use app that is so valuable to me!

Almost everything you need. Where the app exceeds: 
The design is very intuitive and easy to start using immediately 

Standard categories are useful and well designed for tracking. 

The overlapping chart is helpful in comparing effects of categories with each other. 

The reports look really good when generated from the day to day data. 

The ability to create and add categories allows for some customization, and more detailed tracking. 

Where the app falls short:

Tracking how individual foods effect your gut - You can pick how you are feeling for the day, however you cannot pick after each meal or each item you ate. The meal section is in narrative form so you can write in how that meal affected you, but it won’t show as well on the report. 

Multiple Med doses - you can create a Med tab and select meds taken that day. However, if you have a Med you need to take multiple times a day, you will need to make it a narrative format instead of just a tag. Again this will not look as tidy on the report. 

Lack of time tracking - Some categories will track time. Such as time of BMs, but tracking how you feel through the day, or how long after a meal you start to feel worse or better is not easy to do in this app. 

Creating detailed categories - category names can only be 10 caricatures long. So if you are trying to solve the problem of tracking how you feel after each meal, you can’t title the category “after breakfast effects”. 

Conclusion:

All in all a beautifully designed app and easy to use, however if you are really trying to narrow down a specific food and how it affects your gut and how long it takes to affect your gut, and where in your gut it hurts and for how long etc. This app will leave you wanting for more. After using this app for an initial trial I found myself back in the App Store looking for a more detailed bowel tracking app. 

I really hope the developers keep working on this app to improve it, as i would love to continue to use it. I just need the ability to drill down a little deeper than this app is capable right now.
